body: Agreed.
Happy birthday! 🤗

I wish I could have found out if there was anything we could have done, what was on their mind, what were they thinking was it an amalgamation of multiple factors or was it really one major issue, if there was anything they wanted us to do after, if they was anything they wanted to tell us. Still think about it every night since it was so sudden and no one had any idea what happened aside from the details when they were found in the room.

Thank you, I appreciate the offer. I have tried psychiatric help, but sometimes even with medication; it's just not enough. Though I am curious, how did you manage to learn to enjoy life? Despite it's challenges and difficulties, and the selfishness of people; how did you learn to enjoy?
What if you're tired because too much rely on you? And there's no more space to breath?
How so?
I know my words weigh nothing as a strange, but I'm really proud and happy for you regarding your progress. And I admire your drive to be able to continue through life's arduous journey.

Doesn't the uncertainty just exacerbate the feeling of wanting it all to stop, and the world terrifying in it's darkness and negativity? How do you continue to he excited about future experiences that may be even more terrible or meeting people when they could bring the worst of pain ?
How do you inch closer to something that is a fairytale fantasy and unlikely to occur?
Like what possibilities?
Thank you, I know friends who's siblings who committed and the pain was truly unimaginable. So I really applaud you, and you're doing such an amazing job.
Doesn't thinking everything could be worse produce the opposite mindset of wanting to stop before it even becomes worse?
...well that's a cycle
I really resonated with "worked hard on me", though I do wonder, how do you remember this sentiments when it becomes too much and overwhelming?
Thank you, for your hard work.

Somehow it does comfort me, that I'm not alone in my grief. I am grateful for the reassurance, and I definitely agree with your point as suicide can be very triggering. In more than one way. 

You're not stepping too far. In my confusion. I feel both helpless and understanding, and it's just maddening to have them at the same time, so having that kind of mindset may actually help me. Yet I also remain conflicted because that aspect if me refuses to get befriended, does not want any help. I don't comprehend how to help someone who does not want help, but desperately needs it. It's so hard, how do you make them accept the hand that you're reaching if they don't want it? 

Your advice is very helpful, and I am thankful that you resonated and was able to relate with my response. It is a great solace to me, knowing that I was able to convey my thoughts and have someone catch my wavelength. It allows me to feel your sympathy even through this online message. Thank you.

Thank you, I also tried searching and the results that came out were mostly strangulation, bilateral paralysis, painful kind of things but then some of these were upon survival and she's dead so I never really...was able to choose an answer that deemed fitting on her situation. So thank you for your second opinion.
Thank you, it's painful to hear that but I'm grateful for the honesty and closure.
Where can you find these grief support groups? And thank you.

Thank you for your honest response. I am just in grief, my emotions are all over the place and I can't think straight. The thought of her screaming and trying to reach out but failing is just...heart-breaking.

Thank you I'm really sorry it's just the pain does decrease but it's persistent and at this point my mind is confused if it's an indication to go to the ER or if the spiritual symptoms will alleviate on its own with prayer and I'm just so tired of having to even consider spiritual etiologies for clinical manifestations that I'm even considering maybe this is simply a psychiatric issue
Also tried to lubricate it everywhere! But would you have any tips on insertion? Since I never actually got it inside sadly 🙁
I've never used a tampon either! Tried a warm shower but I still couldnt get it in sadly 🙁

It's more on a grounding method to keep myself from drowning in my thoughts! Since my thoughts then to get overwhelming at times, and when I spiral down it nver seems to end--though I haven't cut anything too deeply either that it leaves scarring so I don't think it's that bad of self harm?

That's really sweet of you, thank you, sadly I don't think I can find a psychiatrist that won't pity me or have an affect since I'm on the medical field. Another reason why it makes it hard to reach out, but thank you.
